name: support-bot
description: Domain-specific prompts for a customer support assistant

prompts.text: A customer says their order arrived damaged. Write a short, empathetic reply offering a replacement or refund.
prompts.reference: Apologize, acknowledge the damage, offer replacement or refund, provide next steps.

prompts.text: Explain our 30-day return policy in two sentences a customer can understand.
prompts.reference: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund if unused and in original packaging.

prompts.text: A user cannot log in and has already reset their password twice. List 3 troubleshooting steps to suggest.
prompts.reference: Clear browser cache and cookies, try another browser or incognito, check caps lock and email spelling, contact support to verify account status.
